run_f_gold: run f_gold to check if all array elements can be made same parity by inverting adjacent elements
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple parameter sets and print the number of successful comparisons
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold function that counts odd and even elements to determine parity invertibility
review_f_gold: review the f_gold algorithm that returns false when both odd and even counts are odd numbers
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to accept the full array length automatically instead of requiring an explicit n parameter
